name: aortic_aneurysm_flow
description: Dilated-tube CFD screening scaffold: the aneurysm workflow reuses the verified Poiseuille chain with a larger radius profile; metrics are conservation + WSS scaling laws.

model.geometry: straight tube with 1.6x dilated segment (FluidDomain::cylinder builder + radius profile)
model.fluid: Newtonian 0.0035 Pa.s for the scaling law; blood-analog 0.08 Pa.s for the march
model.law: tau_w = 4 mu Q / (pi R^3); dilated segment carries ~1/(1.6^3) = 24% of healthy-tube WSS at equal flow

metrics.name: low_wss_flag
metrics.assert: dilated-segment mean WSS < 1.0 Pa at mean aortic flow screening conditions

notes: Low time-averaged WSS (< ~1 Pa) is the classical aneurysm-growth risk marker this screening targets.
Full aneurysm sac geometry (bulged 3D mask) lands with mask assembly tools.
